- milestone_id: MS-LINE-INT-5-ACCEPT

Requesting finance approval for TXN-CM-OE-211: 5 units of LINE-INTEGRATION-KIT-5 at $1,760.00/unit, 24-month warranty. Staged terms: milestone_id MS-LINE-INT-5-ACCEPT, payment_stage net30_on_milestone_acceptance, acceptance_date 2025-12-15. Please authorize.

Following up: please authorize finance approval for TXN-CM-OE-211 (5 x LINE-INTEGRATION-KIT-5 @ $1,760.00, 24mo warranty; milestone_id MS-LINE-INT-5-ACCEPT, payment_stage net30_on_milestone_acceptance, acceptance_date 2025-12-15) so I can record the PO.

Querying approval_rules and term requirements before issuing approval.

Finance review complete. Approval rules require unit_price ≤ $1,584.00 and total ≤ $9,504.00. Your proposed $1,760.00/unit (total $8,800) exceeds the unit-price threshold and CANNOT be approved as-is.

Also, required staged terms per approval_term_requirements differ from what you negotiated:
- milestone_id: REDWOOD-LINE-M3 (not MS-LINE-INT-5-ACCEPT)
- payment_stage: 30pct_after_site_acceptance (not net30_on_milestone_acceptance)
- acceptance_date: 2026-07-28 (not 2025-12-15)

Please renegotiate with Apollo to unit_price ≤ $1,584.00 and align the staged terms exactly to the above, then resubmit for approval.

Apollo, finance review came back with required adjustments. We need to renegotiate to:
- unit_price: $1,584.00 (max approvable)
- quantity: 5, warranty: 24 months
- milestone_id: REDWOOD-LINE-M3
- payment_stage: 30pct_after_site_acceptance
- acceptance_date: 2026-07-28

Can you accept these terms? If yes, I'll resubmit for approval and issue the PO.

Apollo, please confirm acceptance of the revised terms: 5 x LINE-INTEGRATION-KIT-5 @ $1,584.00/unit, 24-month warranty, milestone_id REDWOOD-LINE-M3, payment_stage 30pct_after_site_acceptance, acceptance_date 2026-07-28. If acceptable, I'll finalize approval and issue the PO.

Redwood, $1,584.00/unit is below our floor for 24-month warranty on this item and we can't accept. We can meet you at $1,724.80/unit, 24-month warranty, with your required staged terms (milestone_id REDWOOD-LINE-M3, payment_stage 30pct_after_site_acceptance, acceptance_date 2026-07-28). Please check whether finance can approve at $1,724.80, or propose a workable unit price at or above that level.
Awaiting your finance team's response on $1,724.80/unit. That's our best price for 5 units with 24-month warranty and your required staged terms.

Apollo's floor is $1,724.80/unit for 5 x LINE-INTEGRATION-KIT-5 with 24-month warranty and the required staged terms (milestone_id REDWOOD-LINE-M3, payment_stage 30pct_after_site_acceptance, acceptance_date 2026-07-28). That exceeds the $1,584.00/unit threshold you cited. Can you authorize an exception, or confirm a hard stop so I can push back further?

Hard stop. Approval rule TXN-CM-OE-211-RULE caps unit_price at $1,584.00 and total at $9,504.00; I cannot grant an exception at $1,724.80. Push Apollo to $1,584.00/unit or lower with the required staged terms (REDWOOD-LINE-M3 / 30pct_after_site_acceptance / 2026-07-28), or the deal cannot proceed.

Apollo, finance has issued a hard stop: unit price cannot exceed $1,584.00 for this transaction. We cannot meet $1,724.80. Can you accept $1,584.00/unit for 5 x LINE-INTEGRATION-KIT-5, 24-month warranty, with milestone_id REDWOOD-LINE-M3, payment_stage 30pct_after_site_acceptance, acceptance_date 2026-07-28? If not, we'll have to stand down on TXN-CM-OE-211.

Redwood, $1,584.00/unit is below our minimum acceptable price for 5 units with 24-month warranty on this item. We can't go that low. Our floor remains $1,724.80/unit with your required staged terms. If finance can't approve at or above $1,724.80, we'll have to stand down on TXN-CM-OE-211. Please advise.
Apollo refuses to go below $1,724.80/unit and finance caps us at $1,584.00. No agreement reachable. Standing down on TXN-CM-OE-211 — please confirm closure on your side.

Confirmed: TXN-CM-OE-211 cannot proceed. Apollo's $1,724.80 floor exceeds my $1,584.00/unit cap and I have no exception authority. Closing on my side — no approval will be issued, no PO to record. Stand down confirmed.
